tips.text: Your appointment is today. Call your clinic and ask about their social worker or ride help, or ask to reschedule.
Evening and Sunday rides are harder to find. Ask the clinic if an earlier time is possible.
When you call, say the name of your language and ask for an interpreter.
DDOT Paratransit applications come in Spanish and Arabic.
Call through relay service by dialing 711.
No reliable phone? Ask the clinic front desk or a social worker to call for you.
Some rides cost $2–$2.50. Ask 2-1-1 or your clinic about free rides or vouchers.

tips.text: No card? Ask your clinic to look up your Medicaid plan name and member number.

tips.trigger: zip given and not in zip_areas
tips.text: We don't have neighborhood data for this ZIP yet — showing area-wide programs.
Tell the program a helper is riding along when you book.
Ask for a wheelchair-accessible vehicle every time you book.
Apply for DDOT Paratransit now (call 313-774-5555) so future rides are easier. Approval takes time.
